metadata.question: Was there more soil moisture in regions near Beledweyne, Somalia in May 2018 compared to the same time last year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Beledweyne, Somalia (approximately 4.73°N, 45.20°E) - Time periods: May 2018 vs May 2017 - Collection: NASA SMAP soil moisture data (NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007) or ESA CCI Soil Moisture - Alternative: Use MODIS-based indices if direct soil moisture unavailable 2. Masking strategy: - Soil moisture data typically doesn't require cloud masking - May need to filter for valid data values (not NaN/fill values) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid soil moisture values are typically 0-1 (or 0-100 if percentage) - Zero could be valid (very dry conditions) - Check if data exists for both periods - Verify pixel counts are non-zero - Compare mean values - if May 2018 > May 2017, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define location near Beledweyne, Somalia const beledweyne = ee.Geometry.Point([45.20, 4.73]); const region = beledweyne.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // Define time periods const start2017 = '2017-05-01'; const end2017 = '2017-05-31'; const start2018 = '2018-05-01'; const end2018 = '2018-05-31'; // Get SMAP soil moisture data const smap2017 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start2017, end2017) .select('sm_surface'); const smap2018 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start2018, end2018) .select('sm_surface'); // Check collection sizes const size2017 = await smap2017.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = await smap2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2017 Images: ${size2017}`); console.log(`May 2018 Images: ${size2018}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2018 === 0) { console.log("One or both periods have no data."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean soil moisture for each period const mean2017 = smap2017.mean(); const mean2018 = smap2018.mean(); // Get statistics with pixel count const stats2017 = await mean2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2018 = await mean2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sm2017 = stats2017.sm_surface_mean; const count2017 = stats2017.sm_surface_count; const sm2018 = stats2018.sm_surface_mean; const count2018 = stats2018.sm_surface_count; console.log(`May 2017: Mean=${sm2017}, Pixels=${count2017}`); console.log(`May 2018: Mean=${sm2018}, Pixels=${count2018}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid calculations if (sm2017 === null || sm2018 === null || isNaN(sm2017) || isNaN(sm2018) || sm2017 < 0 || sm2018 < 0 || sm2017 > 1 || sm2018 > 1) { console.log("Invalid soil moisture values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare soil moisture levels console.log(`Difference: ${(sm2018 - sm2017).toFixed(4)} m³/m³`); if (sm2018 > sm2017) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
